name: Playable Months by City
description: Monthly disc-golf playability for 15 US cities from NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals (temperature, precipitation, rain days) plus civil dusk.
source: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020, monthly (normals-monthly-1991-2020), NCEI Access Data Service

rule.playable: normal max >= 50F AND normal min >= 28F AND rain days (>= 0.10 in) <= 10

cities.name: Austin

center.method: mean of course coordinates in src/content/courses
